narrative: Q1 2026 closed with steady household progress. Recorded gains came from market participation alongside disciplined saving. Fee drag remained visible enough to merit a focused cleanup this quarter.
performanceExplanation: Market returns were the largest positive contributor in the recorded attribution, while savings and debt paydown added supporting progress. Fee drag remained a smaller offset but still worth simplifying.

recommendations.title: Reduce recurring fee drag
recommendations.description: Review the costliest wrappers first and move the cleanup through a staged household plan. Keep the change list simple enough to complete within the quarter.
recommendations.estimatedImpactSummary: Creates a cleaner long-term cost base.

recommendations.title: Rebuild liquidity routine
recommendations.description: Reset the monthly buffer transfer so cash reserves recover without disrupting the current plan. Revisit the cadence after the next quarter closes.
recommendations.estimatedImpactSummary: Supports steadier liquidity through the quarter.

quarterSummary: The quarter combined forward progress in net worth with a clear opportunity to simplify ongoing costs.
nextQuarterFocus: Start with the fee-efficiency work, then confirm a practical buffer routine for the months ahead.
